rival.name: {rival}
dialog: {rival}: I'm going to be the toughest Trainer there ever was. Just you wait and see!

sailor_1.name: Sailor
dialog: See that great rock out in the water? Squint a little and it looks just like a Pokémon.
Sailors steer by it. Once it's in sight, you know you're nearly home.

pokefan_f.name: Pokéfan
dialog: All the walkways in town are covered in solar panels. They drink in the sunshine all day long.
A city this bright needs a lot of power, and the sun gives us every bit of it!

pokemon_breeder_f.name: Pokémon Breeder
dialog: Sunyshore is one of the busiest ports in Sinnoh.
Ships from all over the world tie up here. You never know who, or what, will step ashore next!

worker.name: Worker
dialog: Our Gym Leader keeps rebuilding his Gym, and every time he switches it on, the lights go out all over town!
Those gears of his gobble up more power than the rest of Sunyshore put together.

sailor_2.name: Sailor
dialog: This whole town stands on walkways, up over the rocks and the waves.
Felt strange when I first came ashore. But people and Pokémon get used to anything, given time.

signs.map_signpost:
Sunyshore City
A bright harbour city, powered by the sun.
signs.gym_signpost:
Sunyshore City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Volkner
The strongest Gym Leader in Sinnoh, and the brightest spark in town!
signs.signboard_vista_lighthouse:
Vista Lighthouse
Its light guides every ship safely into Sunyshore.
signs.signboard_sunyshore_market:
Sunyshore Market
Something new on sale every day of the week!
signs.signboard_julias_house:
Julia's House
Drop in any day: there's a warm welcome for trainers and their Pokémon.
signs.signboard_pokemon_rock:
Pokémon Rock
A rock out at sea in the shape of a Pokémon. Can you tell which?
signs.signboard_blank: Whatever this sign once said, the sun and the salt spray have bleached it away.
